j4q.geometry

Class Vector3

  • java.lang.Object
    • j4q.geometry.Vector3

  • public class Vector3
extends java.lang.Object
    Represents a 3D vector and provides methods for vector arithmetic, scaling, normalization, and geometric operations in three-dimensional space.

    The Vector3 class encapsulates the x, y, and z components of a vector and offers a fluent API for common vector operations.
